historical_reviews.v3_1: Wistron I2C ownership places the path under BMC/platform management, while ED-04 permits conditional automation once the carrier, switch, controller, target and oracle bindings exist.

original_test_intent: Validate the management-I2C connection to the applicable NVSwitch carrier board and its expected management devices while preserving NVSwitch, GPU/NVLink and attached-platform availability.
original_method: The project binds carrier-board and NVSwitch identities, BMC/OOB controller and mux route, allowed targets/registers and expected responses; the agent then performs only approved non-mutating evidence reads with correlated NVSwitch and GPU-fabric health.
manual_activity: The carrier/NVSwitch owner identifies the exact board, switch and GPU-fabric mapping, approves the management route and safe reads, and states independently whether the project includes physical inspection or continuity work.
required_inputs: GPU UUID/physical-position and NVLink topology map
BMC/OOB controller, mux and bus route
Expected carrier management targets and addresses
Reserved reset, power, firmware and thermal-control exclusions
Expected responses, fabric-health criteria and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not infer cable removal or electrical continuity from the item label
Do not guess NVSwitch, GPU or mux identities
Do not scan unknown addresses or access reset/power/firmware-control registers
Do not disturb active GPU/NVLink workloads
Capture complete BMC, NVSwitch and GPU-fabric state without clearing evidence
Stop on switch/target loss, NVLink degradation, GPU XID, bus lock, thermal/power or management anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify carrier, switch and GPU-fabric identities
Validate the supplied management route and read allowlist
After approval, collect only bounded carrier identity/status/telemetry plus correlated NVSwitch/NVLink/GPU evidence
Perform no physical action, reset, write or broad scan
Separate logical coverage from any physical stage
engineer_actions: Approve BMC route, targets and safe reads
Define expected topology and health limits
Authorize maintenance/recovery and any physical stage

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command exists, and avoiding an invented probe is correct. Its physical-continuity framing is not supported by the Master; a safe logical method remains possible only after the exact NVSwitch-carrier route is supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through the approved BMC/OOB vendor interface, read only allowlisted carrier identity/status/telemetry targets and correlate them with immutable NVSwitch, GPU and NVLink topology/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The full NV_SWITCH_CARRIER_BD label, TBD fields and two-minute planning values are preserved; no switch index, GPU mapping, bus, address or register is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES NVSWITCH CARRIER I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint carrier/NVSwitch/GPU topology, capture baseline NVLink and management health, traverse the documented BMC mux path, read approved carrier devices, compare identities/responses with the project oracle, then verify topology, links, XID/events and thermal/power state are unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines conditional logical coverage without fabricating the absent Master procedure or physical continuity task.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Management-I2C responses do not prove carrier connector seating, signal integrity or high-speed NVLink function; correlated fabric state provides impact evidence, not a substitute physical test.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong route or control-register access can reset an NVSwitch, drop multiple GPU links or interrupt accelerator workloads.

project_override_considerations: Logical carrier management connectivity and physical/mechanical continuity are separate possible project stages. The owner must declare both and their evidence; neither can be inferred from this TBD Master row.
expected_evidence: Exact source, carrier PN/revision and applicability
NVSwitch firmware and stable GPU UUID/physical topology
Before/after link health, XID/kernel, BMC SEL/SDR and thermal/power evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: TBD/TBD expresses missing definition rather than contradictory requirements. The manual-continuity interpretation is confined to prior reviews.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The carrier-board management target and read-only evidence class are identifiable; exact topology, route, targets and responses are project inputs. Once supplied, a bounded deterministic plan is possible without changing Master intent.

review_improvement: Replaces unsupported manual-only reasoning with a conditional NVSwitch-carrier management plan and adds stable GPU/fabric identity plus multi-link blast-radius evidence specific to this board.
independent_technical_reasoning: An NVSwitch carrier is not just a generic PCB: one management-path mistake can affect a switch shared by several GPUs and many NVLinks. That demands exact carrier-to-switch-to-GPU mapping and fabric health around any I2C read. Since the Master specifies I2C but no physical action, the capability is conditional automation with critical topology controls rather than an assumed continuity test.
